grouping: Exact REC only; no joins across REC or caller labels.
order: REC lexical, then candidate start onset ascending, then source CSV line.
selection: First admissible 60-second window beginning at a valid call onset and ending no later than the group last annotated end. Require 12–60 wholly contained valid calls, exactly two positive integer local caller labels, >=4 calls each, >=4 positive-overlap A/B pairs. Reject windows intersecting invalid/unknown rows. Omit and report boundary-crossing calls without clipping. Do not rank by score, control contrast, or paper coda type.
quality: Use nClicks-1 positive ICIs, >=2 and <=29 clicks, zero padding, finite nonnegative onset and positive duration. Reject any ICI <=0.0002 seconds (authors flag these) rather than deleting a marker. Require ICI sum and Duration agreement within summed half-last-decimal units plus 1e-12 arithmetic tolerance. Exclude exact repeated rows after first; never silently fill or truncate.
callers: Two annotation-local source labels sorted numerically become A and B.
